final: WITH per_type AS (SELECT tr.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(DISTINCT tx.trdref) AS trader_count FROM transactionrecord AS tx JOIN trader AS tr ON tx.trdref COLLATE BINARY = tr.tradereg COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY tr.tradekind), totals AS (SELECT AVG(trader_count) AS average_count, SUM(trader_count) AS total_count FROM per_type) SELECT trader_type, trader_count, trader_count / CAST(total_count AS REAL) AS share_of_total, trader_count - average_count AS above_average FROM per_type CROSS JOIN totals WHERE average_count IS NOT NULL AND trader_count > average_count
